test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

These were two Indian men who ______ hiding in the forest.
solution:
The correct answer is **"had been."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in past tense, so the correct option should also be in past tense.
 
• **"Had been"** is the correct past perfect continuous tense form of the verb **"to be".**
 
• We use the **past perfect continuous** to talk about actions or events which started before a particular time in the past and were still in progress up to that time in the past.
 
 
• **Example**: *I **had been working**__ on my essays the night before and I was very tired.*
 
 
 
• The use of **"hiding"** suggests that the men were doing something in secret, which makes the past perfect tense appropriate.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct sentence**: *These were two Indian men who __**had been**__ hiding in the forest. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 - "was"** is in the past tense, but it is not the correct form of the verb "to be" in this context.
 
• **Option 2 - "has been"** is in the present perfect tense, which is not appropriate for a sentence in the past tense.
 
• **Option 4 - "have being"** is not grammatically correct. It should be "have been".
